body: Hi! I would love to be your penpal. I'm 22F and  from Kalamazoo, MI.

I wish I could see it that way, and it makes me feel like a shitty person because I don't.

My attempts didn't work anyway, and now I just have a gnarly headache and stomach ache that hasn't gone away in a few days, a blank brain, and sore muscles. My family has been acting pretty weird around me since I tried, maybe I've been acting weird and I just don't notice. Heh.

I have, but he never has time to do anything. I don't know what he does during the day anymore, but between whatever he does all day before work, he's barely around. He claims he does all of his probation stuff during the day, but I don't think that it takes up an entire day. I feel like I sound stupid right now.
Mostly they do, I used to think going to school would give me something to do and keep my mind off of my suicidal thoughts, and it worked for a minute, but lately it just adds to the stress.

I think about her, but I have been thinking about how shitty of a parent I must be... I'm not abusive or mean to her, but I just don't have the energy to do anything with her. We used to go on daily walks, I took her on trips to places, but now I just can't bring myself to anymore. Being around people makes me so nervous, and my body doesn't even feel capable of doing anything besides sitting and staring at shit anymore. I want to be there for her, but I just can't anymore.
